verdict.rationale: Inngest ships official SDKs for TypeScript, Python, and Go with built-in step tooling, retries, and observability, plus AgentKit as a dedicated framework for building AI agents and step.ai.wrap() for integrating OpenAI/Anthropic/Vercel AI SDKs; community reviews confirm strong developer experience building against these SDKs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specifically for the Python/Go SDKs (community feedback is TS-centric) and no public SDK versioning/maturity comparison across languages.
